name: tsundoku-psp
description: Read manga in CBZ format on your PSP with a fast, native reader featuring zoom, auto-crop, and resume support.

paragraphs: tsundoku-psp is a simple manga reader designed specifically for the PlayStation Portable (PSP). If you love reading comics or manga and own a PSP, this app lets you turn your handheld console into a portable library. Instead of carrying heavy books or squinting at your phone, you can enjoy your favorite stories right on your PSP screen.
The name comes from the Japanese word "tsundoku" (積ん読), which means buying books and letting them pile up unread. This app helps you finally read all those digital manga files you've collected!
features: CBZ File Support – Reads CBZ files, which are the standard format for digital comics and manga
PSP Optimized – Designed to work smoothly on PSP hardware
Easy Navigation – Simple controls to flip pages and jump between chapters
Portable Library – Store hundreds of manga volumes on your PSP memory card
Free and Open Source – No cost, no ads, no hidden fees
